notes.title: ver 1.051 Character adjustments + bug fix updates
notes.content:
I have made adjustments to the performance of the characters.
In particular, characters with low win rates or poor usability have been modified.
Fixed known bugs.
The functions of "Change opponent character" and "Exchange with opponent character" have been implemented in the training mode.
Other specifications have been adjusted.

For more information, please visit our development blog.
http://mizusoba.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1140.html

tags.balance_change: In particular, characters with low win rates or poor usability have been modified.

tags.feature: The functions of "Change opponent character" and "Exchange with opponent character" have been implemented in the training mode.

notes.title: ver1.0502 System Update
notes.content:
Improved matching system.
-Added casual matches with no increase or decrease in tier.
Added the ability to detect tiers up to +/- 2 tiers closer to each other.

Expanded training mode.
-Added a tool function.

Added the ability to tie a bring-your-own speca.
Add new titles.
Added a limited number of titles (from the store)
Fixed other bugs.

I will test the new features and then fix the bugs in the new features and the bugs that were not fixed, and update the character adjustments in the next update

Added the ability to detect tiers up to +/- 2 tiers closer to each other.
Added the ability to tie a bring-your-own speca.
Added a limited number of titles (from the store)
